beverloo_rate — DRIVE granular op

• Data kinds: scalar × scalar × scalar → scalar

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.beverloo_rate(D0: 'float', d: 'float', bulk_density: 'float', C: 'float' = 0.58, k: 'float' = 1.4, g: 'float' = 9.80665) -> 'float' (to call the implementation directly, import granular; granular.beverloo_rate(D0: 'float', d: 'float', bulk_density: 'float', C: 'float' = 0.58, k: 'float' = 1.4, g: 'float' = 9.80665) -> 'float'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("beverloo_rate"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

Beverloo の排出則 `W = C ρ_b √g (D₀ − k d)^{5/2}` [kg/s] (Beverloo ほか 1961; 係数 C ≈ 0.58、

k ≈ 1.4 は Nedderman 1992 の整理)。`D0 = 円孔の直径 [m]、d = 粒径 [m]、bulk_density` = かさ密度。

Raises `ValueError: D0 ≤ k d`(有効開口が無い。式は負の底を 5/2 乗できないし、現実には

詰まる)/ いずれかが ≤ 0 / 非有限。`D0/d < 6` 程度では間欠流・詰まりが起きる(式の適用外)が、

それはここでは拒否せず、返りの検査は呼び手に委ねる(閾は材料依存)。
